title: fix(app-shell,components,console): read and offer `http` as the flow HTTP node type (objectui#12742)
body:
Fixes #12742
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`@objectstack/spec` 18 reserves the flow node types `http_request`, `http_call` and `webhook` (objectstack#23954, `f901746a`). The authoring doors refuse them with the rename to `http`, and a stored row loads as `http`. This PR makes the designer and its readers use `http` only. It adds no consumer-side fold of a reserved name.

- **Designer (`flow-node-config.ts`).** The hand-written HTTP field group is keyed `http`. `TYPE_ALIASES` loses `http: 'http_request'` and `webhook: 'connector_action'`, so no alias names a reserved type, and a node typed with one resolves to no group. The `FLOW_NODE_CONFIG_TYPES` doc comment and one `FlowNodeInspector.tsx` comment are reworded.
- **Canvas (`flow-canvas-parts.tsx`).** The icon switch draws the globe for `http`; it used to name `http_request` and `webhook` only, so an `http` node fell back to the task glyph. The tone, category and seed switches drop the reserved cases; they already handled `http`.
- **Simulator and Debug panel.** `MOCKED_SIDE_EFFECT` and `MOCKABLE` list `http` instead of `http_request`. An `http` node is now mocked and gets a mock-output field; it used to pass through unmocked.
- **Viewer (`metadata-viewer.tsx`).** `TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` lists `http` instead of `http_request`, so an `http` node is folded away at business detail.
- **Preview samples.** Both HTTP nodes are typed `http`.
- **i18n.** `engine.flowNode.http_request.label` is removed (`engine.flowNode.http.label` already exists), and the zh field-label block is keyed `http`.
- **Docs.** `packages/app-shell/README.md` now names `http` in place of `http_request` in its two node lists: the flow designer's node types and the simulator's side-effecting nodes.

Out of scope and unchanged: a wait node's `eventType: 'webhook'`; the `'webhook'` action in `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts`; the objectstack consumer bump past `next.2`. This branch merged `main` after objectui#12777, which edits the start group in the same files. There was no conflict.

## Deviations

- The loop-body sample node `charge_fee` also loses `outputVariable: 'charge'`. As `http`, the strict `http` contract applies, and `preview-samples-spec-valid` went red: `Unrecognized key(s) on this http node config: outputVariable`. As `http_request`, the open namespace never judged that key. Nothing in the sample reads `charge`.
- `flow-node-config.inactiveRetained.test.ts`: the ungated-type count is re-measured from 23 to 22, because `webhook` left the alias population.
- The dispatch said the HTTP group draws Durable and Signing secret. It does not: the hand-written group draws Method, URL, Headers, Body and Timeout (ms). Durable and Signing secret come only from the engine's served `configSchema`. The pin asserts the five offline fields and the zh overlay for the two served keys.

## Tests

New pins:

- `inspectors/flow-node-config.httpGroup-12742.test.ts`:
  - an `http` node resolves to Method, URL, Headers, Body and Timeout (ms);
  - no group key and no alias exists for the three reserved names;
  - zh-CN reads 方法 / URL / 请求头 / 请求体 / 超时(毫秒), and 持久化(异步) / 签名密钥 for the served keys;
  - CONTROL: the wait `eventType` still offers `webhook`.
- `previews/flow-canvas-parts.http-12742.test.tsx`: the node card draws `svg.lucide-globe` on `bg-orange-100` (integration). The reserved names fall to the default glyph, tone and category.
- `previews/FlowSimulatorPanel.http-12742.test.tsx`: an `http` step is recorded as `mocked`, a reserved name passes through, and the panel offers the `http` node a mock-output input.
- `components/src/__tests__/metadata-viewer.test.tsx`: an `http` node is folded at business detail and shown at technical.
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/preview-samples-reserved-flow-node-types-12742.test.ts`: sweeps every `nodes` array in `SAMPLES` at any depth. Its lit control checks that `charge_fee` (loop body) and `push` (try region) are `http`.

Retired pins:

- the `http_request` row in `flow-canvas-seeds.spec-parse`;
- the aliases-included control in `flow-node-config.contractKeys-11968`, now an identity control on `http`;
- the test-side `specType` / `designerType` fold helpers in `flowTextSlots.doubleBrace-11824` and `flowValueSlots-12101`.

Every other fixture moved from `http_request` to `http`.

Ablations. Each pin was mutated once. Each run was checked on disk with an anchor count of 1, restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, and blob-compared with HEAD. Every mutation went red:

- group key back to `http_request`: 3 of 4;
- `webhook` alias re-added: 1 of 4;
- zh block back to `http_request`: 1 of 4;
- icon case back to `http_request`: 3 of 3;
- simulator set: 2 of 3;
- panel set: 1 of 3;
- viewer set: 1 of 8;
- sample type: 2 of 2;
- wait `webhook` option removed (control): 1 of 4.

The first run of the group-key ablation was a no-op: its anchor did not match, so the script refused. It was re-anchored and rerun. After all of them, `git diff HEAD` is empty.

At `f8e6d62`:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, in full: exit 0. Test Files 1498 passed and 1 skipped; Tests 14048 passed and 9 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/metadata-viewer.test.tsx apps/console/src/__tests__/`: exit 0, 59 files and 913 tests.

At `91a681f`, the head, which adds only the README commit:

- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0.

At `8e2680b`, the feature commit, before the merge of `main`:

- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console...`: 35 of 35.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/console`: exit 0 each.
- eslint on the changed files: 0 errors.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` and `check:i18n-dead-keys`: exit 0 each.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.

## Screenshots

HotCRM `objectstack dev --fresh` with this branch's console. Studio, HotCRM, Automations, flow Billing Hand-off: Closed Won (`billing_handoff_closed_won`), node Enqueue Billing Hand-off (`send_closed_won_handoff`). 1280 px wide. DOM read at capture:

- [Inspector, light](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/9ade9c2ac0365d06e5c479a925fc7316002e1015/docs/design/findings/12742/inspector-http-light.png?raw=true)
  - Node Type select reads `HTTP`; header reads `Node · HTTP request`.
  - Icon is `lucide lucide-globe` in tile `bg-orange-100 dark:bg-orange-500/15`.
  - Field labels: ID, Label, Node Type, Url*, Method, Headers, Body, Durable, Signing Secret, Timeout (ms).
- [Inspector, dark](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/9ade9c2ac0365d06e5c479a925fc7316002e1015/docs/design/findings/12742/inspector-http-dark.png?raw=true)
  - `html.dark`; the same type, icon and labels.
- [Inspector, zh-CN, light](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/9ade9c2ac0365d06e5c479a925fc7316002e1015/docs/design/findings/12742/inspector-http-zh-CN-light.png?raw=true)
  - Node Type select reads `HTTP 请求`; header reads `节点 · HTTP 请求`.
  - Icon is `lucide-globe`.
  - Field labels: ID, 标签, 节点类型, URL*, 方法, 请求头, 请求体, 持久化(异步), 签名密钥, 超时(毫秒).
- [Debug simulator, light](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/9ade9c2ac0365d06e5c479a925fc7316002e1015/docs/design/findings/12742/simulator-http-mocked-light.png?raw=true)
  - The Debug tab on the flow's page. Mock outputs lists Enqueue Billing Hand-off (`http`) with a mock input.
  - The timeline reads `4 Enqueue Billing Hand-off · HTTP · MOCKED · Mocked http (no backend call).`
  - Icon is `lucide-globe`.

The screenshots live on the evidence branch `claude/issue-12742-evidence`, never merged here.

## Acceptance notes

- An old stored row served through the API was not measured. The installed spec is `18.0.0-next.2`; the card's re-check at the bump stands.
